exercises.title: Exercise 1 — a bonus-transfer transaction with TRY…CATCH and XACT_STATE()
exercises.problemHtml:
Write psm_ChuyenThuong @tuNV INT, @denNV INT, @soTien DECIMAL(10,0), @ketQua NVARCHAR(300) OUTPUT: move a bonus from one employee to another in one transaction. Prove three cases: success (@ketQua = OK), a transfer that would make a bonus negative (CHECK fails), and an unknown destination — in both failures nothing may change and @ketQua starts with FAILED.

Runs on YOUR SQL Server, not in the browser. The in-browser grader runs PostgreSQL (WASM) in a SQL Server–like mode and can only check portable SQL; this task needs T-SQL that only a real SQL Server runs (stored procedures, functions, triggers, variables, TRY/CATCH, transactions…). Nothing here is graded automatically: run the self-check check.sql on your machine and, when it prints ALL 3 CHECKS PASSED, press Mark as solved.

How to run it (Windows or macOS)

Press Tải .zip (download) above the code and unzip it. The folder has three files: setup.sql (re-creates a scratch database DBI202_CL with the sample tables), solution.sql (YOUR answer — edit only this one) and check.sql (3 checks; prints PASS/FAIL for each and ends with ALL 3 CHECKS PASSED). Always run them in this order: setup → solution → check.

  • Windows + SSMS (the course setup, lesson 0.3): open setup.sql → F5; open solution.sql → F5; open check.sql → F5, then read the Messages tab. Or in a terminal inside the folder (sqlcmd ships with SQL Server; otherwise winget install sqlcmd):
    sqlcmd -S localhost -E -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql (use -U sa -P "<password>" instead of -E for a SQL login).
  • macOS (SQL Server in Docker, as in lesson 0.3 — Apple Silicon: mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge, Intel: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest):
    docker run -d --name dbi202-sql -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e "MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=Dbi202#Lab" -p 1433:1433 mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge
    then install the command-line client once with brew install sqlcmd and, inside the folder:
    sqlcmd -S localhost,1433 -U sa -P "Dbi202#Lab" -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql
    (or open the three files in VS Code with the SQL Server (mssql) extension and run them in the same order).

Use CREATE OR ALTER for procedures, functions, triggers and views so that you can run solution.sql again and again. In the real PE you submit only the CREATE … statement, without GO or test commands.

Requirements

  • IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 THROW … after each UPDATE (an UPDATE of 0 rows is not an error).
  • In CATCH: IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION.

# Exercise 3 — composite index: does column order matter? — answer key

1. WHERE depNum = 2 AND empSalary > 60000 can…WHERE depNum = 2 AND empSalary > 60000 có thể…
   Answer: c) seek on depNum = 2 and the salary range inside it
   Equality on the first column, range on the second: the ideal shape.VI: So bằng ở cột đầu, khoảng ở cột hai: dạng lý tưởng.

2. WHERE empSalary > 60000 (no depNum) can…WHERE empSalary > 60000 (không có depNum) có thể…
   Answer: c) not seek: depNum, the leading column, is missing
   Leftmost-prefix rule.VI: Luật tiền tố trái.

3. WHERE depNum = 2 ORDER BY empSalary needs a Sort operator?WHERE depNum = 2 ORDER BY empSalary có cần toán tử Sort?
   Answer: d) No — inside depNum = 2 the index is already ordered by empSalary
   Equality prefix + next column = output already sorted.VI: Tiền tố so bằng + cột kế tiếp = kết quả đã sắp sẵn.

   Answer: d) No — the equality column (depNum) should lead, the range column follow
   A range on the leading column stops the seek from using the second column.VI: Khoảng trên cột đầu làm seek không dùng được cột thứ hai.

exercises.title: Exercise 6 — a partial index (PostgreSQL only)
exercises.problemHtml:
Department 1 is searched by name all day, the others almost never. On PostgreSQL create idx_employee_dep1_name on employee(emp_name) that indexes only the rows of department 1 — smaller and cheaper to maintain than a full index. (SQL Server's closest equivalent is a filtered index: CREATE INDEX … WHERE dep_num = 1.)

PostgreSQL table (tab employee.sql): employee(emp_id, emp_name, dep_num, salary) — 9 rows, departments 1–3. This exercise is graded on real PostgreSQL (lesson 8.4 marks it "PostgreSQL only").

Requirements

  • CREATE INDEX idx_employee_dep1_name ON employee (emp_name) WHERE dep_num = 1;
  • A query can use it only if its WHERE implies dep_num = 1.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Phòng 1 bị tìm theo tên cả ngày, các phòng khác gần như không. Trên PostgreSQL tạo idx_employee_dep1_name trên employee(emp_name) chỉ đánh chỉ mục các dòng của phòng 1 — nhỏ hơn và rẻ hơn khi bảo trì so với chỉ mục đầy đủ. (Tương đương gần nhất của SQL Server là filtered index: CREATE INDEX … WHERE dep_num = 1.)

Bảng PostgreSQL (tab employee.sql): employee(emp_id, emp_name, dep_num, salary) — 9 dòng, phòng 1–3. Bài này chấm trên PostgreSQL thật (bài 8.4 ghi "chỉ PostgreSQL").

Yêu cầu

  • CREATE INDEX idx_employee_dep1_name ON employee (emp_name) WHERE dep_num = 1;
  • Truy vấn chỉ dùng được nó nếu WHERE của truy vấn kéo theo dep_num = 1.

exercises.title: Exercise 7 — a materialized view (PostgreSQL only)
exercises.problemHtml:
The payroll report per department is read hundreds of times a day but the data changes once a month. Create mv_dept_payroll(dep_num, headcount, payroll) as a materialized view — the result is stored and only recomputed by REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW.

PostgreSQL table (tab employee.sql): employee(emp_id, emp_name, dep_num, salary) — 9 rows, departments 1–3. This exercise is graded on real PostgreSQL (lesson 8.4 marks it "PostgreSQL only").

Requirements

  • CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_dept_payroll AS SELECT dep_num, count(*) AS headcount, sum(salary) AS payroll FROM employee GROUP BY dep_num;
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Báo cáo quỹ lương theo phòng được đọc hàng trăm lần mỗi ngày nhưng dữ liệu chỉ đổi mỗi tháng một lần. Tạo mv_dept_payroll(dep_num, headcount, payroll) dạng materialized view — kết quả được lưu và chỉ tính lại khi REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW.

Bảng PostgreSQL (tab employee.sql): employee(emp_id, emp_name, dep_num, salary) — 9 dòng, phòng 1–3. Bài này chấm trên PostgreSQL thật (bài 8.4 ghi "chỉ PostgreSQL").

Yêu cầu

  • CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_dept_payroll AS SELECT dep_num, count(*) AS headcount, sum(salary) AS payroll FROM employee GROUP BY dep_num;
